description: This Swift source file defines the `CronJobsStore` class, a singleton managing a collection of cron jobs, their scheduling, execution, and related state within an application. It also handles gateway push events for real-time updates related to cron executions and status.

classes.name: CronJobsStore
classes.description: A singleton class managing cron jobs and their execution state, integrating with gateway events for real-time updates, providing functions to start/stop scheduling, fetch and modify jobs, and handle related states and errors.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Initializes and starts scheduled polling and event subscription for cron job updates, unless in preview mode.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops all active polling and event tasks related to cron jobs.

methods.name: refreshJobs
methods.description: Fetches the latest list of cron jobs and status from the gateway, updating the local state and handling errors.

methods.name: refreshRuns
methods.description: Fetches execution logs for a specific cron job.

methods.name: runJob
methods.description: Triggers execution of a specific cron job, with optional force parameter.

methods.name: removeJob
methods.description: Removes a cron job by ID and refreshes the job list.

methods.name: setJobEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables a specific cron job.

methods.name: upsertJob
methods.description: Adds or updates a cron job with given payload; refreshes job list afterward.

methods.name: handle(push:)
methods.description: Handles incoming real-time push events related to cron, updating the local state accordingly.

methods.name: handle(cronEvent:)
methods.description: Processes specific cron-related events, triggering scheduled UI refreshes.

methods.name: scheduleRefresh
methods.description: Schedules a delayed refresh of the cron job list.

methods.name: scheduleRunsRefresh
methods.description: Schedules a delayed refresh of the cron runs list for a specific job.
